goals.objective: Research and plan an Agent Skill-compatible image generation LLM execution harness current to June 20, 2026. Cover latest image generation model and paper trends, LoRA/ControlNet/SAM/SAG and related CV-control technologies, ComfyUI full pipeline and custom-node controllability by LLM through Agent Skills/MCP/CLI, prior attempts in GitHub issues/PRs/repos, security/evaluation concerns, and a staged roadmap. No implementation code this turn; deliver cited synthesis and updated local research artifacts.

successCriteria.scenario: Auxiliary/document surface: compile a cited 2026 research synthesis at .omo/ultraresearch/20260620-154100-image-harness/SYNTHESIS.md and update research/ source files; PASS if the synthesis contains source-ranked findings for image models, CV control stack, ComfyUI control, existing attempts, and architecture roadmap with URLs/access dates.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ultraresearch/20260620-154100-image-harness/SYNTHESIS.md plus updated research/*.md source sections; cleanup: no live processes spawned for document evidence.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: SYNTHESIS.md exists and is non-empty; source index and research addenda updated for image models, CV-control stack, ComfyUI control, prior attempts, security, and roadmap; rg heading checks passed; cleanup: all research agents closed, no live server/process left running.

successCriteria.scenario: Adversarial/source-quality surface: verify contested or drift-prone claims using primary docs, GitHub issue/PR/repo search, and at least one direct ComfyUI API/schema or repository inspection artifact; PASS if verify-*.md records URLs/commands proving or refuting full LLM control feasibility and prior-attempt claims.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ultraresearch/20260620-154100-image-harness/verify-comfyui-control.md and wave digests; cleanup: temp clones/processes closed or not used.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: verify-comfyui-control.md records primary ComfyUI docs, /object_info and /prompt control surface, issue #8899 schema gap, PR #13094, MCP issue #7780, closest repos, and commit SHA dc3f8f314a987d23115ed278693e76cf6e72a5a0; conclusion: orchestratable/discoverable but no proven universal semantic-control harness for all custom nodes; cleanup: no temp clone or live ComfyUI process used.

successCriteria.scenario: Regression/local-artifact surface: confirm the existing scaffold remains aligned with the research plan by checking README.md, scaffold/SKILL.md, scaffold/image-generation-harness-SKILL.md, and scaffold/package-shape.md against the final synthesis; PASS if local-findings evidence records any mismatches and no implementation code is modified.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: evidence/local-findings.md updated with artifact alignment check; cleanup: no runtime state.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: evidence/local-findings.md records current scaffold alignment: README/scaffold skill/package-shape fit the final architecture; no implementation code modified; this directory is not a git repository, so git status reports not-a-repo; cleanup: no runtime state or server process.
